entries.constraint: Replace old refund metadata/semantics without replacing the mature Next/React shell.
entries.acceptanceTest: Root shell remains responsive/PWA-safe and renders Project GAS identity without old refund copy.

entries.constraint: Current Privy policy is Twitter/external-wallet and mainnet specific; GAS requires consumer account continuity and bounded financial intent.
entries.acceptanceTest: Auth path matches GAS account policy, preserves explicit authorization scope, and does not expose unnecessary chain configuration.

entries.constraint: Do not preserve old GasCoin destination hierarchy merely because components exist.
entries.acceptanceTest: Desktop and mobile navigation implement approved GAS IA and primary journeys within benchmark action counts.

entries.constraint: Social is a product layer; do not recreate /community as a disconnected forum.
entries.acceptanceTest: Global/following activity integrates with identity and actionable GAS result objects while preserving feed position/navigation state.

entries.constraint: Old refund/points metrics cannot silently become GAS reputation metrics.
entries.acceptanceTest: Player/Crew rankings derive from approved verifiable GAS metrics and expose loading/error/recovery states.

entries.constraint: Old treasury semantics must never imply that game bankroll or GAS-denominated liquidity equals external backing.
entries.acceptanceTest: Home live state separates account, network, reserve and game activity truthfully.

entries.constraint: Preserve GAS visual identity; references provide behavioral evidence, not replacement branding.
entries.acceptanceTest: Canonical token map documents typography, surfaces, spacing, motion and breakpoints and is used by GAS components.

entries.constraint: Live game/social/monetary state must distinguish optimistic UI from canonical settlement truth.
entries.acceptanceTest: Query/state layer supports explicit pending/settled/error states and safe reconciliation after refresh.

entries.constraint: Only approved GAS identity/reputation signals may be surfaced as verified performance.
entries.acceptanceTest: Identity API exposes canonical profile/activity data with privacy and integrity rules documented.

entries.constraint: UX may not invent referral emissions or reward economics.
entries.acceptanceTest: Referral/invite UX uses approved economics and prevents misleading pending/earned states.

entries.constraint: CRUISE/BOOST/REDLINE, IGNITION, GAS GAUGE, GameBankroll firewall and informed risk presentation are canonical.
entries.acceptanceTest: Core Play journeys J02/J03/J04/J12/J13 meet approved benchmark/recovery targets.

entries.constraint: 2% GAS trading fee must remain distinct from game economics and expected receive/fees must be clear before confirmation.
entries.acceptanceTest: Buy/Sell GAS journeys meet J08/J09 and never require manual contract/RPC knowledge in normal supported flow.

entries.constraint: External-only backing; rebase must show direction, magnitude and personal balance impact without inventing open monetary parameters.
entries.acceptanceTest: J10/J11 pass and reserve/game/account/Bracket domains cannot be visually conflated.

entries.constraint: Raw provider/RPC errors cannot be the primary consumer message; money state and one safe action must be clear.
entries.acceptanceTest: Refresh, reconnect, duplicate-submit, delayed settlement and provider failure tests pass without money-state ambiguity.

entries.constraint: Use the existing runner rather than a parallel test framework.
entries.acceptanceTest: Core journeys emit comparable action/timing/state metrics and approved regressions fail CI.
